description: Erection of 2 single storey blocks comprising of five sheltered accommodation units in the grounds of the convent.
site_name: St Marys Convent And Nursing Home
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewithDrawing Numbers 004-A, Flood Defences Map, Design and Access Statement received 18/09/12.
Drawing Numbers 100D, 151C, 152C, 155C, 154C, 201C, 202C, 002C, 003D, 001C, 300B, received 24/101/2
Arboricultural Method Statement received 04/12/12.
 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - Before any works commence on site, an ecological survey of the trees to be felled shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before any works commence on site, details of the design of building
foundations and the layout, with positions, dimensions and levels, of service trenches, ditches, drains and other excavation on site, insofar as they may affect all trees and hedgerows on or adjoining the site, most specifically those identified as 128C and 130C within the Arboricultural Method Statement, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. If it proven that trees 128c and 130C cannot be retained, details of the location, size and species of their replacements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Details of the size, species and location of all replacement tree(s) not covered by Condition 5 of this consent, including the replacement or replacement of the trees referred to as T39-42 within the Arboricultural Method Statement, shall be agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing before commencing the work permitted, and shall be planted within [3] months from the date the trees required to be felled by this approval are felled or, if this period does not fall within a planting season, by 31 January next.

Condition : 7 - Details of any floodlighting/other lighting in the garden shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before the building(s) is / are occupied. The equipment shall be installed, operated and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme.

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted begins [or is occupied] arrangements shall be agreed in writing with the local planning authority and be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area (define) at any time.

Condition : 10 - The applicant should implement a drainage scheme in accordance with the hierarchy of drainage options for surface water drainage as identified in London Plan policy 5.13. This shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
